[SWS_DM_00228] Switch to requested Diagnostic Session
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04198, RS_Diag_04248
⌈
On positive evaluation of a DiagnosticSessionControl request, the
Diagnostic
Server instance
shall send the positive response message. After the response
message is sent, the Diagnostic Server shall internally switch to the
Diagnos-
ticSession
with
id
matching the requested Subfunction value, and shall set
new timing parameters according to the associated parameters
p2ServerMax
and
p2StarServerMax
.
⌋
